primitives.proofs: Chaum-Pedersen and disjunctive Chaum-Pedersen, Fiat-Shamir over merlin 3 transcripts (STROBE-128), protocol label d2.booth/1
primitives.key_generation: joint Feldman VSS (Pedersen 1991), k-of-n, Schnorr proof of the constant term, Lagrange at zero
primitives.signatures: Ed25519 (RFC 8032) over SHA-256("d2.booth.ballot/1" || 0x00 || canonical JSON of the ballot with signature "")
primitives.board: SHA-256("d2.booth.entry/1" || 0x00 || seq be64 || prev || kind || 0x00 || canonical JSON payload); canonical = sorted keys, compact, integers only

must_fail.name: edited_ballot_without_rehash
must_fail.note: A ballot's first ciphertext is replaced in place; the entry hash no longer matches.

must_fail.name: removed_ballot
must_fail.note: A re-vote is dropped and the chain rehashed; the aggregates change, so the guardians' decryption proofs (which are over the real aggregates) fail.

must_fail.name: edited_ballot_rehashed
must_fail.note: An operator rewrites a ballot's ciphertext and rehashes the chain; the voter's signature no longer verifies.

must_fail.name: ballot_moved_to_another_nym
must_fail.note: A ballot is relabelled with another signed-up pseudonym; the registered key differs.

must_fail.name: ballot_for_another_round
must_fail.note: A ballot says it belongs to another round.

must_fail.name: duplicate_signup
must_fail.note: The same pseudonym signs up twice.

must_fail.name: signup_key_changed
must_fail.note: A sign-up's key is replaced; the pseudonym's ballots no longer match it.

must_fail.name: ballot_before_signup
must_fail.note: A ballot entry is placed where a sign-up was (kind changed); the payload has the wrong shape.

must_fail.name: ballot_after_close
must_fail.note: A partial decryption entry is relabelled as a ballot; a ballot after close is out of order.

must_fail.name: guardian_commitment_edited
must_fail.note: Guardian 1's constant-term commitment is swapped for guardian 2's; the proof of knowledge fails.

must_fail.name: round_key_edited
must_fail.note: The published joint key is not what the commitments derive to.

must_fail.name: partial_decryption_share_swapped
must_fail.note: Guardian 1's share for option 0 is replaced by its share for option 1; the Chaum-Pedersen proof fails.

must_fail.name: partial_decryption_duplicated
must_fail.note: A guardian publishes twice.

must_fail.name: tally_count_moved
must_fail.note: One vote is moved from option 0 to option 1; the sum still matches but the decryption does not.

must_fail.name: tally_count_inflated
must_fail.note: One vote is added to option 0; the counts no longer sum to the counted ballots.

must_fail.name: tally_below_threshold
must_fail.note: The tally claims to use one guardian where two are needed.

must_fail.name: tally_uses_absent_guardian
must_fail.note: The tally names a guardian that published no partial decryption.

must_fail.name: no_tally
must_fail.note: The board stops before the tally.

must_fail.name: ballot_payload_edited_unsigned_field
must_fail.note: An extra field is added to a ballot; unknown fields are refused.

must_fail.name: hash_edited
must_fail.note: An entry's hash is replaced by another 32-byte hex value.

must_fail.name: seq_edited
must_fail.note: An entry's sequence number is changed.

must_fail.name: unused_ballot
must_fail.note: A pseudonym's only ballot is dropped; the aggregates change and the decryption proofs fail.

must_fail.name: threshold_edited
must_fail.note: Threshold raised to 3 after the fact; guardian commitments have the wrong length.

must_fail.name: bad_option_count
must_fail.note: Params say two options; ballots have three.
